parts.name: Screen Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen side of the laptop, typically made of aluminum alloy for durability and heat dissipation.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the display panel and webcam, providing the visual interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to open or close the laptop.

parts.name: Base Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the base side of the laptop, made of aluminum alloy for structural support and heat management.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the keyboard, touchpad, and internal components such as the motherboard and battery.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while supporting the screen and user input components.

parts.name: Connector
parts.Basic_description: This is the connector or hinge part of the laptop, made of stainless steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the screen and base, allowing smooth rotation and maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates to enable the opening and closing of the laptop.

parts.name: Decoration (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a decorative or branding element on the laptop, typically made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves aesthetic and branding purposes, sometimes covering screws or seams.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.
